mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with positive PAYEMS MoM change, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0%, persistent inflation triggers central bank hawkishness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal weakening demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with both HOUST and RSAFS declining MoM, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.0% sustained for 3 months), higher discount rates depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months during FEDFUNDS > 3.0% sustained cycle, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with positive INDPRO MoM change, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (RSAFS > 500,000 and HOUST > 1300), elevated economic risks cause S&P 500 underperformance, leading to negative 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months meeting late-cycle expansion condition, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.
